$comment: The one list of what XDRProof reported upstream. tools/upstream-table.mjs writes it, with each report's status from GitHub (findings/upstream-status.json), into README.md, findings/REPORT.md, the docs and the org profile; never edit those copies by hand. kind: new (a bug nobody had reported), fix-offered (a tested fix on an open issue), evidence (data added to someone else's report). Our issue's or comment's time comes from GitHub; replies are counted after it. fix: our tested branch, when there is one. org_label: the link's words on the org profile, when not just the issue.
author: Blockchain-Oracle
